name: Qlippoth, Wilbopik
body:
QLIPPOTH, WILBOPIK
CR 15

XP 51,200
CE Huge outsider (aquatic, chaotic, evil, extraplanar, psionic, qlippoth)
Init +8; Senses aura sight 80 ft., darkvision 60 ft., pierce the veils, scent; Perception +32

DEFENSE

AC 30 touch 12, flat-footed 26 (+4 Dex, +18 natural, –2 size)
hp 217 (15d10+135); fast healing 10
Fort +18, Ref +9, Will +15; +24 vs. mind-affecting effects
DR 15/lawful; Immune cold, poison, mind-affecting effects; Resist acid 10, electricity 10, fire 10

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 80 ft.
Melee 6 tentacles +26 (1d8+5 plus disease and grab)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks horrific appearance (DC 23), psionic fist +2, violent destruction (30 ft., 15d8, DC 27)
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 15; concentration +20)

Constant—aura sight, personal barred mind, pierce the veils
At Will—cloud mind* (DC 23), complex false sensory input* (DC 23), greater psychoport (self plus 50 pounds of material only), mind thrust (15d10, DC 23), moment of terror (DC 19, penalty even on successful save), wrench
3/day—alienation (5 targets, DC 23), anchored navigation, psionic blast (6 rounds, DC 23), quickened wrench, remote viewing (DC 19, 40 ft.), sensory cascade (DC 19, permanent)
1/day—beckoning*, mindhunter

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 18, Con 29, Int 19, Wis 22, Cha 21
Base Atk +15; CMB +27 (+31 grapple); CMD 41 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Greater Psionic Fist, Improved Initiative, Metapsionic Ability (wrench, Quicken Power ), Power Penetration, Psionic Fist, Psionic Meditation, Unavoidable Strike, Weapon Focus (tentacle)
Skills Autohypnosis +24, Intimidate +23, Knowledge (engineering) +22, Knowledge (geography) +19, Knowledge (planes) +19, Perception +32, Spellcraft +22, Stealth +19, Survival +24, Swim +36; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception, +4 Stealth, +8 Swim
Languages Aklo; telepathy 1 mile SQ amphibious, anomaly field, plague sense

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Anomaly Field (Su)

The area out to one mile around a wilbopik is difficult to interact with using magic or psionics. Scrying abilities targeting the area automatically fail, and extradimensional travel within the area is barred as per dimensional lock. A wilbopik can suppress or reactivate this ability as a standard action

Qlippoth Corruption Disease (Su)

natural attack—injury; save Fort DC 23; onset 1 day; frequency 1/day; effect 2d4 Wis and 2d4 Cha drain; cure 2 consecutive saves.

The save DC is Charisma-based.

Horrific Appearance (Su)

Creatures that succumb to a wilbopik’s horrific appearance take 1d6 points of Wisdom drain and are staggered for 3 rounds

Plague Sense (Su)

When a wilbopik detects a creature with its scent ability, it automatically knows whether that creature has been corrupted by qlippoth corruption, is currently affected by qlippoth corruption, or is not affected by qlippoth corruption.

ABOUT

A carapaced globule seems to drift through the water, its shell pocked with soft and pulsating craters. A single eye-lined tentacle extends downwards from the bottom, the end splitting into six grasping strands that monitor the surrounding waters. Wilbopiks serve as sentries for the qlippoth of Vandara, harnessing their clairsentient abilities to locate any being that would cross the southern waters.
